name: Physical Abuse
overview: Scripture teaches that physical harm, including physical abuse, is subject to just consequences, as Leviticus 24:19 emphasizes the principle of equitable retribution for causing injury. Believers are called to love others deeply, even their enemies, fulfilling the law through love as Romans 13:8 and Luke 6:27 instruct. While wrongdoing such as works of the flesh are clearly condemned (Galatians 5:19), repentance and receiving the Holy Spirit provide a path to transformation and healing (Acts 2:38). Trusting in God's protection and abiding in His presence (Psalms 91:1) offers refuge for those who suffer harm, including within the context of marriage.
